title: Midcentury Ink Cartoon — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: The idea goes up and connects
scenes.purpose: One economical cel gesture (raising a lit idea) followed by a single lateral set shift, which opens a connected-system card.
visuals: Stationary halftone dot grain on a flat teal sky
Flat ochre swoosh and red sun shifting at half parallax
Ink stick figure drawn as four held cels
Paper card holding a six-node network
Dark green ground band with fixed caption

beats.development: Held thinking pose: figure cradles an unlit bulb at chest, head down. Line 1 of the caption is readable.

Fast change into the key silhouette: anticipation cel (0.70s), stretch cel with the bulb lit (0.87s), then the key arm-up cel (0.97s). Sparks pop in steps and the set starts its single sideways follow to the right.
A dotted lead line draws from the bulb, then the paper card grows from where the line lands.
Nodes pop in steps and links draw one after another inside the finished card; line 2 of the caption wipes in; the hub node turns red at 2.30s.
Settled hold on the key pose with the finished system and the full caption.

findings: Long opening hold, then a swift three-cel change into the key silhouette, as the style asks.
The only camera move is one lateral follow from 0.85s to 1.45s.
justifiedHolds: 0–0.7s opening pose hold sets up the gesture and gives line 1 time to read.
2.35–3s final hold lets the full caption and the finished system read.
